sentences.text: Subsidy Scheme for Self-help Groups of Minorities

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Subsidy Scheme for Self-help Groups of Minorities" aimed at empowering minority women by providing financial support to Self-Help Groups (SHGs). The scheme offers a subsidy to SHGs engaged in various self-employment activities, promoting economic self-reliance among minority women.
**Who is this for:** Self Help Groups (SHGS); Category: Women and Child; Sector: Financial Assistance

**Detailed Description:** The "Subsidy Scheme for Self-help Groups of Minorities" was launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka, and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme provides a subsidy of 50% of the unit cost or a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- to the self-help groups of the minority community to engage in various types of self-employment activities and make them economically self-reliant, on the loans obtained from various financial institutions recognized by the Nationalized/Scheduled Bank/RBI. An SHG is to make fixed savings and provide internal lending to the members of the group as per requirement from the savings amount of the SHG.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Subsidy Amount:** 50% of the unit cost or a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- to the self-help groups.  **NOTE:** - The subsidy will be adjusted against the repayment of the loan taken by the SHG from recognized financial institutions. - SHGs focusing on good internal loan repayment will be given higher priority for the subsidy.
